import re, hashlib, json
paths=[Path('docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-17-aheart-ui-v2-amendment-a2-draft.md'),*Path('docs/superpowers/plans').glob('2026-11-17-aheart-ui-*.md'),Path('evidence/M2/decision-log.md'),Path('evidence/M3/decision-log.md'),*Path('evidence/V0').rglob('*.md')]

for p in paths:
 for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text()):
  if target.startswith(('https:','http:','#')): continue
